content:
Apple is launching a new free trial offer that lets customers receive the perk when they buy an eligible hardware product, including the just-announced iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.

Those who purchase the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and iPhone Duo will be able to unlock a three-month trial of the Apple One bundle.

For reference, Apple One bundles together Apple Music, Apple TV, Apple Arcade, iCloud storage, Apple Fitness+, and Apple News+ under one umbrella at a lower price than subscribing to each service individually.

Apple One comes in three tiers: Individual, Family, and Premier.

The Individual plan includes 50GB of iCloud storage, the Apple Music Individual plan, Apple Arcade, and Apple TV.

The Family plan includes 200GB of iCloud storage and access to the Apple Music Family plan for up to six people. The most expensive Premier tier, meanwhile, offers 2TB of iCloud storage and includes News+ and Fitness+.

If you accept the Family or Premier trial under this new promotion, you can share it with up to five family members via Family Sharing.

Per Apple's terms and conditions, the perk will be available for eligible iPhone, iPad, and Mac purchases starting September 17, though it's unclear exactly which products aside from the new iPhones will be included.
